# Three genuinely different answers · S06

A starting approach, B improving a part, Q changing its mechanism. Separate generation and comparison phases retain all alternatives and criteria. Drag strengths to another approach or use Borrow; snapshots keep their origin and flag later source changes. Selecting a test does not erase alternatives. Editable examples, local workspaces, grouped Undo and Markdown/JSON via creative-kit. No automatic novelty or quality score; the mechanism difference is an explicit user claim. Tests cover source preservation, changed-source flags and portable state.

Combined into the Alternatives workbench (`../objections/`) on 2 October 2026. This earlier route and its saved work remain usable. The new workspace copies local work or this tool’s JSON exports, retaining all three mechanisms, criteria, tests and borrowed-strength snapshots.
